name: Girls Just Want to Have Fun

podcast.body: Cyndi Lauper's "total reboot" of Robert Hazard's obscure song, which she reimagined and transformed into a feminist anthem. Her version reached number two on the Hot 100 in early 1984, successfully launching her hitmaking career. "Lauper's total reboot of Girls Just Wanna Have Fun reached number two on the Hot 100 in early 1984 and launched Cindy's Hitmaking"

podcast.body: This song was a number two hit for Cyndi Lauper and was part of the string of successful singles from her debut album, "She's So Unusual." It was a prominent pop anthem of 1984, emerging from the "cauldron of 83." "The number two hit girls just want to have fun."

podcast.body: This song was one of four top-ten hits for Cyndi Lauper that were either released or peaked in 1984, making it a pivotal year for her career. "Girls just want to have fun, time after time, she-bop, and all through the night. All of which were released or peaked in 1984."
